breakdown.reason: The generated specification consistently applies ISPIN = 1 to all three relaxation steps (CO, surface, and adsorbed system) without any mention of allowing spin polarization for surface-containing steps. This matches the ground truth which removes the contradictory note about allowing spin polarization for slab steps.
